title: Temperature Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Prompt Engineering
description: An interactive bar chart of candidate next tokens showing how the temperature parameter reshapes the probability distribution, with live sampling that builds a sentence one token at a time.

learningObjectives: Demonstrate how the temperature parameter changes the probability distribution of token selection
Predict the effect of temperature on output creativity
prerequisites: Models generate one token at a time

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Live parameter manipulation with raw and adjusted values shown side by side
keyQuestions: Why is temperature 0 right for extraction and wrong for creative writing?
If a model gives a different answer each time, is that a bug?
commonMisconceptions: Believing temperature makes the model smarter or more knowledgeable
Believing high temperature adds new information rather than reweighting existing candidates
assessmentOpportunities: Predict the output at temperature 0 before running it
Recommend a temperature for an unfamiliar task and justify it
